measurement.name: marker_provenance_loss_total
measurement.reported_by: POST /marker response field and a brain-api warning log line with marker_type and marker_id

interfaces.POST /marker: response adds marker_id and marker_provenance_loss_total; action replayed with idempotent_replay true for a recorded marker id; 403 when a granted worker claims a project outside its grant
interfaces.GET /marker/{marker_id}: marker_type, vault_path, canonical_marker_id and the provenance read back from the vault file; 404 outside the caller grant
interfaces.KB_WORKER_TOKENS: brain_id@projA|projB=token grants a worker token those projects only; brain_id=token unchanged
interfaces.storage: frontmatter keys on signal and decision files; an inline @provenance comment on the entry header of lesson and milestone logs; registry brain-feed/markers/<marker_id>.json under a flock
interfaces.milestone_routing: attrs project, then the repo segment of project_id, then source as a compatibility path for clients with no project attribution; a granted worker routes only into granted projects
interfaces.replay: outbox drains map the buffer's folder field to cwd instead of project and keep the source ts

rollback.action: old marker readers keep working: lesson and reconcile hashes cover entry bodies only, the header comment and extra frontmatter keys are ignored by existing parsers; deleting brain-feed/markers only drops replay acknowledgements beyond the cache window
rollback.rehearsal: test_a_lesson_log_written_before_provenance_still_dedups_and_reads_back and the unchanged test_marker suite (unit level, mocked)

limitations: no metrics sink exists in the kernel; the measurement is a response field and a log line
signal crash recovery scans the newest SIGNAL_DEDUP_SCAN_MAX signal files, so a retry after more newer signals than that writes a duplicate
flock gives exclusion across processes on one host and across hosts only where the vault mount honours flock
a worker token with a project grant may still write unattributed markers, which stay unattributed and are hidden from scoped readback
